title: qcom-next SHA-pinned topic configuration
description: Single source of truth describing the content of the qcom-next integration tree. qcom-next is a deterministic function of base.sha, the ordered topics list, and the rerere cache revision. Every base and topic entry must carry a concrete SHA (FR-INT-03): generation never consumes a branch tip, because that would make the result depend on when it ran rather than on this file. qcom-next must never be hand-edited; it is published only by the publication workflow driven by this file.

schema_version.description: Config format version. Bump only for breaking changes; validators reject unsupported values.

base.description: Upstream kernel baseline that topics are merged on top of. Changed only by an RC uprev PR (Phase A).

branch.description: Baseline branch that ci-merge uses as the merge base (maps to the 'baseline' row of the generated merge.conf).

tag.description: Upstream tag/RC label the baseline corresponds to, e.g. v7.3-rc1. Null only during bootstrap.

sha.description: Pinned baseline commit. Mandatory: tree generation must not depend on where a branch happens to point when it runs (NFR-01).

promotion_state.description: open = topic promotions may publish. frozen = RC uprev in progress; promotion PRs may validate but must not publish or merge (FR-RC-03).

rerere_cache.description: Shared git rerere cache replayed during tree generation. Normal PR CI consumes it read-only.

ref.description: Branch of the rerere cache repository to use.

sha.description: Optional pinned rerere cache commit. When set, tree generation is fully reproducible (NFR-01).

topics.description: Topic branches merged into qcom-next, in merge order. Array order IS the merge order and must respect depends_on.

gitSha.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex commit SHA. Abbreviated SHAs are rejected so the config is unambiguous.

gitHttpsUrl.description: HTTPS git URL. Tokens must never be embedded here.

gitRefName.description: Valid git ref name per git-check-ref-format: no leading slash, no empty components, no '..', no '@{', no '.lock' component, no space ~ ^ : ? * [ backslash or control characters, no trailing slash or dot.

name.description: Topic identifier. Must be unique. Used as the ci-merge remote name, as the override/<name> ref name, and as the key into topic_maintainers.json. Conventionally equal to branch.

branch.description: Topic branch name. Must still exist (V4); renaming or deleting requires removing or updating this entry (FR-INT-02).

sha.description: Pinned stable topic commit: a SHA that already passed the CI gates. Mandatory (FR-INT-03). A new topic is added only together with a concrete SHA; generation never falls back to the branch tip, because that would make the tree depend on when it ran rather than on this file (NFR-01). Resolving a tip to a concrete SHA is the job of the bootstrap and promotion steps.

tag.description: Tag pinning sha so it survives a topic-branch rebase (FR-INT-01). Convention: <branch>-<kernel-version>-<YYYYMMDD>, e.g. tech/bsp/clk-7.3-rc1-20260907, with .1/.2 collision suffixes. Null only while bootstrapping or for a new topic whose tip has not yet been tagged.

depends_on.description: Names of topics that must merge before this one. Used to validate merge order and to justify an atomic multi-topic promotion (FR-DEP).

comment.description: Optional free-text note for maintainers. Has no effect on generation.
